name: NodeJS – Katabump Mode
author: chatgpt@samkiel.dev
description: High-performance NodeJS egg modeled after Katabump hosting. Supports ES modules, PM2, Git deployment, and production npm workflows.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
\
apt update -y
\
apt install -y git curl unzip python3 make g++
\

\
cd /mnt/server
\

\
# KATABUMP-STYLE BEHAVIOR: Auto-git if provided
\
if [ ! -z "${REPO_URL}" ]; then
\
  echo "Cloning project from ${REPO_URL}"
\
  if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
\
    git clone ${REPO_URL} .
\
  else
\
    git clone --branch ${BRANCH} ${REPO_URL} .
\
  fi
\
fi
\

\
# Install dependencies (Katabump mimics clean npm install)
\
if [ -f package.json ]; then
\
  echo "Installing production dependencies..."
\
  npm install --omit=dev
\
fi
\

\
echo "Installation complete."
\
exit 0

variables.name: Start Command
variables.description: Command used to launch the bot.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Optional: Auto-deploy your bot using Git.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Default is main. Only used if REPO_URL is set.
